Code Versioning system usedGit
Software Code Language usedServer: RubyClient: HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Compilation requirements, Operating environments & dependenciesRuby 2.4, bundler gem and development libraries for Ruby, mysql and/or sqlite3 are needed.Ghostscript required for extraction of images from PDFs.Runs on Linux (tested on Ubuntu 14.04 and 16.06), Windows (tested on Windows 7 and 10) and MacOS (tested on High Sierra).See Manual for detailed instructions.
If available Link to developer documentation / manualAPI documentation: https://www.buhos.org/api/clbustos@gmail.com
Support email for questions

Permanent link to executables of this versionFor Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS and RHEL, use packages available on https://packager.io/gh/clbustos/buhosFor Windows, installer available on https://www.buhos.org/windows-download/Latest code available on: https://github.com/clbustos/buhos
Legal Software LicenseBSD-3
Computing platforms/Operating SystemsServer: Any platform that compiles Ruby 2.4. Tested on Ubuntu 14, Ubuntu 16, Windows 7 and Windows 10.Client: Any standards-compliant browser. Tested on Firefox and Chrome.
Installation requirements & dependenciesLinux packages and Windows installer provide all necessary dependencies.Using source code, Ruby 2.4, bundler gem and development libraries for ruby, mysql and/or sqlite3 are needed. Extraction of images from pdf requires ghostscript. See Manual for detailed instructions
If available, link to user manual – if formally published include a reference to the publication in the reference listEnglish and Spanish manuals are available, respectively, at:https://www.buhos.org/manual/en/https://www.buhos.org/manual/es/
